open_points.subject: scope of the personal-data guarantee for direct agent access to microservices
open_points.text: “Personal data — values of class `personal_data` (K-14) reach an agent only as digest and class; the owner alone reads them” and “no agent ever holds it” conflict with “An agent's own access to a service — as for processing a photo … is granted by that service and the owner outside the kernel” and “its personal-data promise (K-14) covers what the kernel itself returns.”
open_points.question: Does the prohibition on an agent receiving personal data apply only to values returned through the kernel surface, or also to the agent's direct access to microservices outside the kernel?
options: Limit K-14 to the kernel surface and permit service-authorized direct access to personal data
Apply the prohibition globally and forbid direct agent access to personal data
open_points.default_guess: Limit K-14 to the kernel surface, because the changed exclusion states that scope explicitly.
